summary: Douglas County tower listed as completed by May 1932 in a newspaper item; the register lists it as gone and no site description was found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source I read describes what remains.

events.note: Listed as already completed on 13 May 1932 (quoted 1932 newspaper item); the start of construction is not given

evidence.supports: Summit is in Douglas County, Conservation Department District 1

evidence.quote: The towers already completed are: Summit (Chaffey) in district 1.

evidence.supports: item dated 13 May 1932, attributed to The Post-Crescent
evidence.quote: May 13, 1932: "The towers already completed are: Summit (Chaffey) in district 1." (The Post-Crescent)

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap point named Summit Lookout Tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: OpenStreetMap has a named tower point at the spot; the register's Gone is followed, since a map point does not show whether a structure stands.

notes_for_editor: Only three sources. The 1932 date comes from a newspaper item quoted second-hand on a hobby history site, and it shows completion by May 1932, not the construction date. The item names it Summit (Chaffey); no source read explains the second name. Gone status and coordinates match the register and the local ffla dataset. No description of the site today was found.
